description: TDM Fast unofficial modified test build with an independent user profile.
post_install: if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Launch.cmd failed. Exit all TDM Fast instances, including the system tray, before installing or updating.' }

script: if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Restore-original.cmd failed. Exit all TDM Fast instances, including the system tray, before uninstalling.' }

notes: Installation launches the app. Exit all TDM Fast instances before installing, updating or uninstalling; closing the window may leave the app in the system tray.
Use tdmfast-modified-test or the Start menu shortcut (Launch.cmd). Running TDM Fast.exe directly uses a different profile. UserData is persisted across updates and normal uninstalls.
Uninstallation runs Restore-original.cmd before removing this copy; it does not alter a separate original installation.
Unofficial experimental build: resuming unfinished downloads after restarting the app may corrupt files. Create a new download instead. Mandatory updates remain enabled and may be unstable.
Do not run this copy and the original together; both use port 37651. The optional Chrome extension is in resources\extension.

The bundled yt-dlp reads your global yt-dlp configuration. If YouTube reports 'The page needs to be reloaded' when using account cookies, add --extractor-args "youtube:player_client=default,web_embedded" to that configuration. Reinstalling yt-dlp-ChromeCookieUnlock recreates its configuration and removes custom options.
